hero_lede: Pick a group and subject, then open a path. Content comes from data files — not hard-coded UI.
empty_catalog: No paths in this catalog yet.
login_lede: Enter your email and we send you a one-time 8-digit code. New users register with a first name, last name, and email. No password.
path_map_lede: Each square is a topic — with learning steps inside. Pick a topic or start from the beginning.
record_hint: Optional recording — if the browser supports it.
stats_message: Great job — you finished the path!
stats_message_retry: Worth revisiting a few steps to strengthen.
gate_practice: Finish this step before moving on.
empty_tab: No paths in this tab yet.
home_tabs_lede: Tabs show paths you started, finished, or should revisit. The full catalog stays available.
login_email_note: The cookie stores only an opaque id. Email is an identity, not a password.
err_name_required: First and last name are required.
err_email_taken: That email is already registered — try again or check the details.
err_email_change_disabled: Your sign-in email can only be changed with “Change email” below (codes to both addresses).
add_path_gate_lede: Add-path builds a full learning path with an agent. Grok is reached through Cloudflare AI Gateway; the xAI key stays in Cloudflare Secrets Store (BYOK). MyRoad never accepts that key.
add_path_criterion_met: Cloudflare AI Gateway is configured and responded. No provider API key was sent by MyRoad.
add_path_next_steps: Fill in the goal to start building. You or the agent can publish.
security_note_body: MyRoad does not accept, store, or send an xAI or other provider API key. Keys stay in Cloudflare Secrets Store. This POC does not persist secrets in the database, cookies, localStorage, or logs.
add_path_not_configured_hint: Add the xAI key once in the Cloudflare dashboard as BYOK alias default. MyRoad only needs the account id and gateway name in the server environment.
err_gateway_not_configured: Cloudflare AI Gateway is not configured. Set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_GATEWAY_ID on the server. Do not paste an xAI API key into MyRoad.
err_gateway_request: Cloudflare AI Gateway request failed. Check the gateway and the BYOK xAI key in the Cloudflare dashboard, not in MyRoad.
login_new_lede: First name, last name, and a unique email. No password.
login_have_account: Already registered? Sign in with email
settings_lede: Name, email, and interface language. Language is chosen here only.
builder_lede: Describe a goal. The agent drafts an outline, fills each topic, and saves a draft you can review and publish.
builder_gateway_ready: Grok is reached through Cloudflare AI Gateway (BYOK). The server environment is set.
builder_missing_env: Cloudflare AI Gateway is not configured. Missing on the server: {names}. Do not paste an xAI API key into MyRoad.
builder_demo_offer: You can still try the whole flow in demo mode: it builds a full Hebrew sample draft (12+ stages) without Cloudflare. Demo drafts are labeled as demo.
builder_goal_hint: For example: fractions for beginners, or the present simple tense.
builder_mode_demo: Demo mode (no model call, Hebrew sample)
builder_err_goal: Please write a goal of at least 3 characters and pick valid options.
builder_existing_lede: Published paths in {subject}. Open one, or continue to a new draft.
builder_existing_none: No published paths in this subject yet.
builder_outline_lede: Check the outline. You can edit titles and order, then approve to start building.
builder_err_outline_edit: The edited outline is not valid. Titles cannot be empty.
builder_build_lede: One model call per topic. Each topic is saved to the draft as soon as it is filled.
gen_err_gateway_not_configured: Cloudflare AI Gateway is not configured on the server. Use demo mode or set the gateway variables.
gen_err_gateway_request: The Cloudflare AI Gateway call failed ({detail}). Check the gateway and the BYOK key in the Cloudflare dashboard, then try again.
gen_err_bad_reply: The model reply could not be used, even after one repair attempt: {detail}. Try again.
gen_err_save_failed: The draft could not be saved ({detail}).
gen_err_internal: Something went wrong while building ({detail}). Try again.
gen_err_short_bad_reply: Model reply was not valid JSON
builder_complete_ok: The path is complete: at least 3 topics and 12 stages, and every topic has explanation, practice, and check.
builder_publish_note: You or the agent may publish. The published version is never changed; feedback creates a new draft.
builder_published_ok: Published. The path is now in the catalog and plays in the player.
builder_feedback_lede: Feedback creates a new draft version. The published version stays as it is.
builder_feedback_topic: Rebuild a topic with this feedback
builder_feedback_whole: No rebuild, just record it on the new draft
builder_nothing_built: No topic has been built yet.
builder_footer: Drafts are saved in the platform PathStore with an agent id.
draft_problems_none: No problems found in the draft so far.
draft_problem_review_kind_invalid: Step “{title}” has review topics but is not a valid review step (kind “{kind}”).
draft_problem_review_topic_unknown: Review step “{title}” mixes a topic that does not exist in the path: {topic}.
draft_problem_review_topic_not_earlier: Review step “{title}” mixes topic {topic}, which does not come earlier in the path.
draft_problem_missing_title_he: The path has no Hebrew title (titles.he).
draft_problem_missing_blurb_he: The path has no Hebrew description (blurbs.he).
draft_problem_bad_subject: The path has no valid subject: “{subject}”.
draft_problem_no_nodes: The path has no steps yet.
draft_problem_node_correct_missing: Step “{title}” has answer choices but no correct answer.
draft_problem_node_correct_not_in_choice: Step “{title}”: the correct answer “{correct}” is not one of the choices ({choices}).
draft_problem_node_invalid: Step “{title}” has content that is not valid.
draft_problem_topic_unknown_nodes: Topic “{topic}” points to steps that do not exist: {ids}.
builder_publish_blocked: Publishing is blocked by format errors ({count}). Fix them and try again:
login_code_lede: If {email} can sign in, we sent a 8-digit code to it. A code works once and expires in 15 minutes.
login_code_restart: Use a different email or send a new code
err_code_required: Enter the 8-digit code from the email.
err_code_wrong: That code is not correct. Try again.
err_code_expired: The code expired. Request a new one.
err_code_used: That code was already used. Request a new one.
err_code_locked: Too many wrong tries. Request a new code.
err_too_many_codes: Too many codes were requested for this email. Wait 15 minutes, or sign in from a device you used before.
err_mail_failed: We could not send the email. Try again later.
builder_match_found: Existing paths that fit your goal ({count}). Open one, or build a new path anyway:
builder_match_prereqs_done: you already finished what it requires
err_code_slow_down: Too many wrong tries from here. Wait a little and try again.
err_captcha_required: Please complete the check and try again.
err_account_limited: Too many wrong codes for this email today. Try again later, or sign in from a device you used before.
settings_email_change_pending: To change {current} to {new}, enter the code sent to each address. Your email stays the same until both codes check out.
settings_email_changed: Your email was changed. Other devices were signed out.
